div.head: IV Eg 13.1
div.ab: Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum, hwylce steore hy be þan healdan willað.
Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum, hwylce steore hy be ðan healdan willað.

Et si quis michi adherentium huic ordinationi resistens hoc deuitat, nec iniuriam illis aut aliquibus inferre formidat, quę lex et iustitię rectitudo ad hoc aput Danos sit statuta, sciscitetur et perquiratur.
Gif hit þonne min gerefa oððe ænig oðer man, riccre oððe unriccre, onscunað ⁊ ungerysena gebyt aðer oððe tunesmannum oððe heora hyrdon, ceose Dene be lagum hwylce steore hy be ðan healdan willað.

Wenn dies aber mein [Domänen-]Amtmann oder irgend jemand sonst, mächtiger oder weniger mächtig, verweigert und Ungebührliches entweder den Bauern [seines] Dorfes oder deren Hirten gebietet, so mögen die Dänen [Nordleute] gemäss [ihrer] Verfassung entscheiden, welches Strafrecht sie dabei beobachten wollen.

But if my [demesne-]reeve or anyone else, more or less powerful, refuses this and imposes something improper on either the villagers or their herdsmen, let the Danes [Northmen] decide according to [their] laws what penalty they will apply in that case.

If, however, any reeve of mine or any other man, whether of high or low position, refuses this, and offers any indignity to either the villagers or their herdsmen, the Danes shall determine, according to their constitution, what penalty they will fix for this offence.

If then my reeve or any other man, in high or low position, refuses it, and offers indignity either to the villagers or their herdsmen, the Danes are to decide by law what punishment they wish to apply in that matter.

Der Eigentümer eines Herrschaftsguts oder sein Vogt; s. d. Gl 5A. Vgl. Urk. cyning oððe ealdorman oððe oðer rica a. 970 Bi 1267. Versio übersetzt nur ungefähr
The owner of a manor or his reeve; see that word in Gl 5A. Cf. the charter cyning oððe ealdorman oððe oðer rica a. 970 Bi 1267. The Versio translates only approximately
Durch onscunian wird resistere der Bibel übs.; Gen. 50, 19
Onscunian translates the resistere of the Bible; Gen. 50, 19

Versio denkt mit Unrecht an allgemeine Schädigung der Dorfbauern durch die Domäne, weil sie für gebeodan die Bed. ‘offerre, bieten’ hier unpassend wählt. Eg aber straft hier nur denjenigen herrschaftlichen Eingriff, der die Untersuchung der Herkunft verdächtigen Viehs hemmt

The Versio wrongly thinks of general harm done to the villagers by the demesne, because for gebeodan it chooses here the inappropriate meaning ‘offerre, offer’. Eg, however, here punishes only such interference by the lord as obstructs the inquiry into the origin of suspicious cattle
Versio scheint sich den Text in ceose man mid Dene [der Acc. müsste auffallen] zu emendieren
The Versio seems to emend the text for itself to ceose man mid Dene [the acc. would be striking]
Liebermann understands this to refer to the lord of the manor or his steward.
